observations.title: Integrated Social Trend Atlas Report
observations.boundary: The social atlas synthesizes public-signal and paid-research inputs; discussion and trend signals are not representative prevalence, causal effects, or market size.
observations.headline: The atlas points to an adaptation economy: people and institutions are buying control, proof, substitution, resilience, and workflow leverage in response to instability.
observations.method: Combines executive findings, level synthesis, theme/subtheme compendium, proof cards, paid evidence, and completion audit into one integrated report.
observations.artifact_evidence_boundary: This report is writing-ready but not claim-final. Preserve the per-theme claim limits and validate market, policy, clinical, financial, and geopolitical assertions before external publication.
